$schema_purpose: Human/tool-readable reference for the dataset shape FORESIGHT Nexus expects. This file documents the contract; it is NOT read or enforced by the application at runtime. The single source of truth for actual validation and cleaning is data/loader.py — duplicating that logic here as a second, silently-drifting implementation would be worse than not having this file at all.

required_columns.name: date
required_columns.description: Transaction/observation date. Parsed with pandas.to_datetime; unparseable rows are dropped (see data/loader.py::clean_dataset).

required_columns.name: product_id
required_columns.description: Stable unique identifier for a product. Used as the grouping key for every per-product calculation.

required_columns.name: product_name
required_columns.description: Human-readable product name, shown throughout the UI.

required_columns.name: quantity
required_columns.description: Units sold/demanded on that date for that product. Coerced to numeric; negative values are clipped to 0 with a note in the cleaning log.

optional_columns.name: category
optional_columns.description: Product category, enables category-level analytics and grouping. Features depending on it are skipped (not faked) when absent.

optional_columns.name: price
optional_columns.description: Unit price. Enables inventory value and reorder-value financial metrics; those metrics are explicitly reported as unavailable when this column is missing.

optional_columns.name: revenue
optional_columns.description: Revenue for that date/product row, if tracked separately from price × quantity.

optional_columns.name: promotion
optional_columns.description: Whether a promotion was active on that date — informational; not currently used as a model feature.

optional_columns.name: supplier
optional_columns.description: Supplier identifier — informational; not currently used in any calculation.

optional_columns.name: lead_time
optional_columns.description: Supplier lead time in days. Falls back to Settings > Default Lead Time when missing for a product.

optional_columns.name: inventory
optional_columns.description: Units on hand as of that date. Required for every inventory/risk/recommendation feature — those pages show an explicit empty state when this column is absent, rather than fabricating stock levels.

notes: Validation, column mapping, and cleaning logic live in data/loader.py.
This file exists for onboarding/documentation and for any external tooling that wants a machine-readable contract — it deliberately contains no logic of its own.
